description:
Story Saver - Instagram Downloader 
Instagram is among the leading social networking platforms in the world with above 1 billion monthly active users. There are millions of cool photos, videos, and stories posted daily on this social network, and this has turned it into a huge online stock of videos and images. However, unlike other social media sites such as Facebook or Pinterest, Instagram does not provide a way for its users to save/ download the contents. It’s so inconvenient to Instagram fans! But don’t worry, Story Saver for Instagram will help you solve this problem. 
Story Saver is a free photo and video downloader app for Instagram. We create the cool app to help users easily to save photos, videos, GIFs, and aminations from Instagram posts, stories, highlights, and TVs. All contents will be retained the quality of the originals and saved to the device's gallery in seconds. Users can manage the downloaded files directly on the app and play these videos with the build-in app player. Our Story Saver app also supports downloading many videos simultaneously, so time-saving and convenient! Besides being a photo and video downloader for Instagram, Story saver is also a repost app. After downloading, users can use the app to repost the photos and videos directly on their own Instagram account without using any other reposting app. More and more to explore!
Key features of Story Saver:
●	Save Instagram stories, posts, highlights, and TVs
●	Repost photos and video on Instagram
●	Support multiple accounts
●	Multi-video download
●	High download speed
●	Retain quality of the original
●	Manage saved contents directly on the app
●	Play videos saved on the in-app player
●	Easy to use
●	Free to install
How to save a photo or video from Instagram and repost it:
1.	Open Story Saver and log into your Instagram account.
2.	Select the post or story you'd like to re-post on the main screen
3.	Click on the content and tap on "Download" to save it.
4.	Tap on "Repost" in the pop-ups.
5.	Choose the location you want to reshare on.
6.	Edit and add captions for the content and tap on "Share" to repost it.
Story Saver is now available for free on Play Store, so let's install and enjoy it!
